Verses and themes from the text are quoted or discussed across later canonical and paracanonical literature, including the *Mahāniddesa* (Mnd 16 *Sāriputtasuttaniddesa*), the *Kathāvatthu* (Kv 3.9), and several dilemmas in the *Milindapañha* (Mil 7.2.1, 7.5.7, 7.6.10).

 Many stanzas correspond to verses in the *Dhammapada* (Dhp 76, 77, 98, 99, 315) and their counterparts across parallel Dharmapada and Udānavarga recensions, including the Gāndhārī Dharmapada, the Patna Dharmapada, the Sanskrit *Udānavarga*, Tibetan versions, and early Chinese verse anthologies (T 210, T 212, T 213).
